title: hibiscus trionum var. vesicarius
intro: Hibiscus trionum var. vesicarius, commonly known as the bladder hibiscus or bladder ketmia, is a perennial herb in the mallow family that is native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections due to its diuretic properties. The bioactive constituents of hibiscus trionum var. vesicarius include flavonoids, saponins, and mucilages, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and soothing digestive issues. Furthermore, its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties make it a potential remedy for various health conditions, including kidney stones and menstrual cramps.
